extracted.name: Tangy (Not Sweet) Tartar Sauce
extracted.description: Dill pickle juice gives this tartar sauce a tangy flavor.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir the mayonnaise, onion, pickle, and pickle juice together in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, and celery salt to taste. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.
